tool_args.rationale: The short-window positive-gain data are consistent with multiple mechanisms, while the target horizon is far beyond the observed range. A slow-horizon discriminating observation is the minimal relevant probe to test endogenous reversal before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations cover only H=0.16–0.48 and all show positive gain, so they cannot identify a slow negative adaptation component for the requested H=24.5 forecast.
That batch targets coupled memory ODE identification; the observed signature and archive candidate point to a long-horizon reversal instead.
Nuisance auxiliary measurements do not resolve the central long-horizon ambiguity.
